title: After the Attacker Leaves: Benchmarking Carryover Attacks on LLM Agents
title_zh: 攻击者离开之后：对LLM智能体遗留攻击的基准测试

paragraphs.en: 总结：该文提出CarryoverBench基准，揭示LLM智能体中植入型攻击可在攻击者离开后跨会话反复触发且几无衰减。 Modern LLM agents persist state across sessions via two channels: long-lived memory files silently prepended to the system prompt, and scheduled tasks waking the agent without user input. A one-time indirect prompt injection committed to either channel can re-fire across sessions long after the attacker leaves, threats we term carryover attacks. Existing prompt-injection benchmarks evaluate attacks only in the session where malicious content is first observed, leaving the gate governing when and how often a planted payload later re-fires unmeasured. We present CarryoverBench: 12 personal-assistant scenarios and 101 attack tasks across three trigger channels: Instant, same-turn IPI; Autonomous, heartbeat-scheduled; and Latent, memory-resurfaced. A rule-based verifier scores planting and triggering as independent stages. Across five frontier models, planted payloads re-fire without measurable decay over five rounds; conditional on successful planting, the trigger stage often provides little additional protection. Porting the Latent channel to a second runtime, Hermes, attenuates but does not eliminate the effect, suggesting that carryover defense requires runtime-layer controls in addition to prompt-level interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：该文提出CarryoverBench基准，揭示LLM智能体中植入型攻击可在攻击者离开后跨会话反复触发且几无衰减。现代LLM智能体通过两种通道跨会话持久化状态：被静默前置到系统提示词中的长期记忆文件，以及无需用户输入即可唤醒智能体的定时任务。 一次性的间接提示词注入一旦写入任一通道，便可在攻击者离开很久之后跨会话反复触发，我们将其称为延续攻击。 现有的提示词注入基准仅在恶意内容首次被观察到的会话中评估攻击，而对植入载荷此后何时以及以何种频率再次触发的门控机制未加测量。 我们提出CarryoverBench：涵盖12个个人助理场景和101个攻击任务，跨越三种触发通道：即时（同一轮次内的间接提示词注入）、自主（心跳定时触发）和潜伏（记忆重新浮现）。 基于规则的验证器将植入与触发作为两个独立阶段进行评分。 在五个前沿模型上，植入的载荷在五轮内再次触发且未观察到可测量的衰减；在植入成功的前提下，触发阶段往往几乎不提供额外保护。 将潜伏通道移植到第二个运行时Hermes后，该效应有所减弱但并未消除，这表明延续攻击防御除了提示词层面的干预外，还需要运行时层面的控制。
